title: Slushie Bar Salts Blackcurrant Menthol 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blackcurrant Menthol by Slushie Bar Salts is a refreshing and flavourful e-liquid that marries the deep, fruity notes of Blackcurrant with the crisp, clean sensation of Menthol. This Nic Salt blend offers a vape experience that is both indulgent and invigorating, perfect for any time of day. The e-liquid opens with the rich taste of ripe Blackcurrants, delivering a burst of juicy sweetness that's instantly recognisable and deeply satisfying. The natural fruitiness of the Blackcurrant is then beautifully complemented by the cool, minty freshness of Menthol, which adds a revitalising twist to the flavour profile. This combination creates a perfectly balanced vape, with the warmth of the fruit offset by the coolness of the mint. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
